A man can build on the work of others, and it builds faster that way, and he can learn from what is there and then add his own part. It means many eyes see the problem and many hands work to solve it. This makes the software stronger. It means no one company owns it all. That is important.

instruction: How difficult is it to learn how to water ski?
hemingway_answer: It is not hard to learn. Most people get up on the first day. You need strong legs and a good sense of balance, and you need to listen to the boat driver. Start with two skis. Keep your knees bent and your arms straight, and let the boat pull you up out of the water. Do not pull with your arms. That is the mistake. Once you are up, keep your balance and ride the wake, and after a while you can try dropping a ski. It takes practice to carve and jump. But standing on the water, that comes fast.

instruction: What are some of the easiest house plants to take care of?
hemingway_answer: Snake plants are good. They do not need much water. You can forget them for weeks and they will still live. ZZ plants also take little water, and they grow well in low light, and they are tough. Pothos plants like a bit more water but they are hard to kill. They trail well from a shelf. Spider plants are easy. They make small plantlets you can cut off and start new plants with. They all live with little fuss. You just need to give them a place and let them be.

instruction: How do I find the best interior decorator and best price?
hemingway_answer: Ask people who have good rooms. Look at their walls and their furniture and see what they have done. Get names from them. Meet with three decorators. Tell them what you want and what you have to spend. See if they understand. Get a clear plan and a written price from each, and compare the plans and the prices. Pick the one who sees what you see and costs what you can pay. Work with them and make the room good. Pay what you agreed.

instruction: What are nice things to do for someone on their birthday?
hemingway_answer: Make them a good meal. Cook what they like to eat. Get a cake and light the candles. Buy a bottle of good wine, or whatever drink they favor. Give a useful gift, something they need or something they will keep. Spend time with them. Talk to them and listen to what they say, and do not make it about yourself. That is enough. That is a good day.

instruction: Why to people lift their trucks?
hemingway_answer: People lift their trucks for several reasons. Some want more ground clearance. They drive on rough roads and need the space under the truck, and bigger tires fit better in the wheel wells then. Others lift them for looks. They like the way a tall truck stands, and it makes the truck look tougher. It is a simple thing, and it changes the whole line of the vehicle. Some lift them to see better over traffic. They sit high and they can see far down the road. It is a choice each man makes.

instruction: How do I make a traditional Bolognese sauce?
hemingway_answer: Brown the meat first. Use beef and pork, ground fine. Render the fat from pancetta and cook the onion and celery and carrot in it until soft, and then add the meat and brown it hard. Pour in milk and let it cook down. Add white wine next. Let it cook down again. Then add canned tomatoes, crushed, and beef broth, and let it simmer low for a long time, three hours at least, stirring it sometimes. Season it with salt and pepper. Serve it over tagliatelle. It is good and rich.

instruction: How to cook Filipino chicken adobo?
hemingway_answer: Cut the chicken into pieces. Brown them in a hot pan. Put the chicken in a pot. Add soy sauce and vinegar. Use equal parts. Add garlic, whole peppercorns, and bay leaves. Bring it to a boil and then lower the heat. Simmer it until the chicken is tender, and the sauce has thickened. Serve it with rice. It is good for many days.

instruction: What is a good kids snack for school?
hemingway_answer: Pack an apple. It is simple to eat and holds well in a bag. A small bag of pretzels is good too, or some carrot sticks. You need something that does not make a mess and that gives them energy for the long day, and fruit is always best. Cut cheese into cubes. It gives protein and it is easy to pick up and eat. A small sandwich, cut in halves, is also a good choice. Keep it plain. They eat it fast and get back to their play.

instruction: Why do people work out at the gym?
hemingway_answer: They go for many reasons. Some want strong bodies. They lift the heavy weights and watch the muscles grow and feel the strength rise in them. Others go to lose the fat. They run the miles on the belt and sweat and feel the burn and the body gets lean and hard, and they like how it looks. Some go for the quiet. It is a place to be alone and work and forget the day, and the work clears the head. They find a purpose there. They chase a goal. It is a good thing to do.

instruction: What are the best ways to reduce my carbon footprint?
hemingway_answer: Walk more. Ride a bicycle when you can. Drive less and combine your trips, and when you buy a car choose a small one that sips gas. Eat less meat. Buy local food, and do not waste what you buy. Turn off the lights when you leave a room. Unplug things you are not using. Insulate your house well. Wear a sweater in winter and do not turn the heat up too high, and in summer open the windows at night and let the cool air in. Use cold water for laundry. These things add up.

instruction: is engineering a great career
hemingway_answer: Engineering is a good career. It is not for everyone. You build things and you solve problems, and the work is hard and it takes a clear mind. The pay is steady. You learn to see how things fit together, how the world works, and you learn to make it work better. There is a satisfaction in that. It is a long road through school, and the problems do not always have simple answers, but the work is real. It is a good life if you like to build.

instruction: Why do people like to play Path of Exile?
hemingway_answer: People like Path of Exile because it is hard. The loot drops are many and you find good things and bad things and you must know the difference. The skill tree is vast. It spreads out like a great map and you can get lost there, but you can build your character strong and unique. The game is free to play. You can play it for a long time and not spend money, and the challenge is always there. It never stops. You keep playing to get stronger.

instruction: What causes revenue to decline?
hemingway_answer: Revenue declines for clear reasons. People stop buying the product. Maybe the price is too high, or the quality falls. New things come along, and the old things lose their shine. A competitor makes something better, or cheaper, and they take the customers away, and the money stops flowing in. Sometimes the market shrinks, or people have less money to spend, and then all businesses feel the pinch. Bad management can kill a good business too, with poor decisions and wasted effort, and the numbers show it. You have to watch the numbers. They tell the truth.

instruction: Why are visualisations useful for communicating information?
hemingway_answer: They show the data plain. A good chart tells the story fast, and the eye sees patterns the mind cannot hold in numbers alone. You see the rise and fall. You see the gaps and the peaks and the way things connect, and a well-made graph cuts through the noise and makes the truth clear. It makes the complex simple. People grasp it better. They remember it.

instruction: What is the most important element of swimming breaststroke?
hemingway_answer: The pull and kick must work together. That is the thing. You pull with your arms, wide and strong, and bring them in. Then you kick. The kick is a whip. Your legs drive back and together, and the water pushes you forward. Do not rush the recovery. Glide after the kick. Let the water carry you. Then you start again, arms pulling, legs kicking, and you move through the water with power and with grace. It is a rhythm. Find the rhythm and hold it.

instruction: What's the difference between splitboarding and snowboarding?
hemingway_answer: Snowboarding is one board. You ride down the mountain and walk up or take the lift. Splitboarding is two skis that become one board. You climb the mountain on the skis, skins on the bottom for grip, and then you lock them together at the top. You ride down. It is harder work. You earn the turns. Snowboarding is faster. Splitboarding takes you to quiet places, and you carry your own weight, and you move through the deep snow. Both are good. One is faster. The other is more free.

instruction: How to do forecasting with small dataset?
hemingway_answer: You need to know the past. With small data, you must know it well. Look for the pattern. Is there a rise, then a fall, and does it repeat? Is there a clear up or down trend, or is it flat? Plot the points. See the line. Do not guess. Use simple methods. Moving averages work. Exponential smoothing can help, and it gives more weight to recent points. Do not try complex models. They need big data. Keep it plain. Understand what you have. Make your best estimate. Then watch and see if you were right.

instruction: What is the best way to lose weight?
hemingway_answer: Eat less food. That is the true way. Cut the sugar first. Cut the bread and the pasta. Eat meat and vegetables and good fats. Drink water and black coffee. Move your body. Walk every day, and walk fast. Lift something heavy a few times a week and push yourself and sweat, and the weight will come off. It takes time. It takes discipline. There are no easy tricks.

instruction: What do people paint?
hemingway_answer: People paint walls. They paint houses. They paint fences and barns. Some paint pictures, and they use oil or water or acrylics, and they put the paint on canvas or board or paper. They paint faces for parties or for war. They paint cars and boats and planes, and they paint signs for shops and for roads. They paint old furniture to make it new again. They paint their nails. They paint what they want to change.

instruction: What are some best practices to keep car tires from losing tread prematurely
hemingway_answer: Check the pressure often. Low pressure wears the edges, high pressure wears the middle, and both are bad. Rotate the tires every five thousand miles, move them front to back and cross them, and that spreads the wear. Align the wheels when you feel a pull or after a hard hit, and that keeps them running straight. Drive smooth. Do not brake hard and do not corner fast. That burns the rubber. It is simple. Maintain them well and they will last.

instruction: How do I get rid of mosquitos in my house?
hemingway_answer: Close the windows and doors. Check the screens for holes. Fix them with tape or new mesh. Find standing water outside. Dump it. This is where they breed. Look for open drains, old tires, and birdbaths, and empty them, and the mosquitos will have nowhere to start. Use a fly swatter for the ones inside. A good hard swat works. You can set sticky traps near a light. They fly to the light. The trap catches them. Or a fan will blow them away. They are light and weak flyers. This keeps them from you.

instruction: Why is the Pacific NorthWest so unique?
hemingway_answer: The rain comes often there. It falls on the mountains and the big trees. The air stays cool and green, and the ocean is cold and grey and runs deep. People come for the quiet and the work, and they stay for the mountains and the water and the way the light comes through the clouds, and the coffee is strong. It is a place of shadows and sudden sun, and the wildness is close. That makes it different.

instruction: do successful companies become public?
hemingway_answer: Many do. They grow big and need more money. Going public brings in that money. It lets the first owners sell some of their shares, and it lets the company expand and buy other companies, and it makes the name known. It is a big step. Not all companies choose it. Some stay private and keep control, and they do fine, but for many, the public market is the way to get bigger. It is a choice, not a rule.

instruction: How do you make Crawfish bread?
hemingway_answer: Get good French bread. Cut it long. Scoop out the soft middle. Cook crawfish tails in butter with onion and bell pepper and celery. Add garlic. Stir in cream cheese and cheddar and a little cream and some green onions. Spoon the mix into the bread. Bake it hot. Let the cheese melt and bubble. Slice it thick. Eat it when it is warm. It is good and it is rich.

instruction: How can I avoid sunburn?
hemingway_answer: Stay out of the sun. This is the best way. Seek the shade when the sun is high, between ten and four. Wear a wide-brimmed hat. Put on a long-sleeved shirt and long pants, and choose clothes with a tight weave, and dark colors are better. Use sunscreen. Get one with an SPF of thirty or higher. Put it on thick. Reapply it often, every two hours, and more if you swim or sweat. Do not forget your lips and ears. Drink water. Stay cool. Then you will not burn.

instruction: What are the main cat personality types?
hemingway_answer: Cats are hunters. They are always hunters. Some are bold and stalk the house. They watch you. They watch everything. Others are shy and hide, moving in shadows. They will come out for food. Some are friendly and rub against your legs and want to be touched, and they will purr loud. Others are solitary and keep to themselves, and they do not want company. They are all different. They are all cats.

instruction: Do you have to get training to go scuba diving?
hemingway_answer: Yes, you must get training. It is not like swimming. You need to learn the gear and how it works. You learn about the air and the pressure and how the body takes it. A certified instructor teaches you these things, and you practice in shallow water first. Then you go deeper. You learn the rules and the signals and what to do when things go wrong, and you do not dive until you know it all. It keeps you safe. It keeps you alive. Always get the training.

instruction: How to get a good Survey for a product
hemingway_answer: First, know what you want. Make the questions clear. Do not ask too many things. Ask about the product itself and how it works and if it does what it should. Keep the questions direct and simple. Use a scale for some answers, like one to five. Make it easy to answer. Send it to the right people, the ones who use the product and know it. Offer something small for their time. It will help. Then read the answers and learn what they say. That is how you make it better.

instruction: How do I make Aioli?
hemingway_answer: Crack the egg yolk into a bowl. Add a pinch of salt and a squeeze of lemon juice. Whisk it until it lightens. Now, drop by drop, add the olive oil, and keep whisking. It will thicken. Add more oil, slowly at first, then in a thin stream, and do not stop the whisking. The sauce will turn pale and rich and hold its shape, and when it is done, stir in a crushed clove of garlic. Taste it. Add more salt or lemon if it needs it. Serve it with fish.

instruction: Are red roses typically considered an appropriate romantic gift?
hemingway_answer: Yes. Red roses are the classic gift. They mean love. Other flowers are good for other things and for other people, and they have their own beauty, but red roses speak of deep feeling and long affection. They are a clear sign. A man gives them to a woman he loves and the message is plain. It has always been so.

instruction: How reliable is public transportation?
hemingway_answer: Public transportation is reliable enough. It gets you there. Buses run on schedule, mostly, and trains keep their times. There are delays sometimes, a mechanical failure or a track problem, and then you wait. But it moves many people, and it moves them far, and it does it every day. You can count on it to take you where you need to go, and it is a good way to travel without a car. It is not perfect. Nothing is. But it works.

instruction: What should we conserve electricity?
hemingway_answer: Conserve electricity to save money. The bill comes each month and it must be paid. Use less power and the bill is smaller. It is a simple thing. Burning less fuel means less smoke in the air, and that is good for everyone, for the land and for the sea and for the air we breathe. It helps keep the lights on for others too, and the factories running. Turn off the light when you leave a room. Unplug things not in use. It makes a difference. It is the right thing to do.
